has_removed_export.instructions: Does this change remove or un-export a public function, class, type, or module symbol that consumers may depend on?

criteria.true: A public export or symbol was removed

has_renamed_field.instructions: Does this change rename a public field, property, or JSON key in an API or schema contract?

criteria.true: A public field or key was renamed

has_type_change.instructions: Does this change alter the type, format, or nullability of a public field or return value in a breaking way?

criteria.true: A breaking type or format change is present
criteria.false: No breaking type change worth flagging

has_new_required_field.instructions: Does this change add a new required field or parameter to a public API, schema, or request body?

criteria.true: A new required field or parameter was added
criteria.false: No new required field worth flagging

has_endpoint_change.instructions: Does this change remove, rename, or change the HTTP method or path of a public API endpoint?

criteria.true: A public endpoint was changed or removed

has_enum_break.instructions: Does this change remove or rename a value from a public enum, union, or status code set?

criteria.true: A public enum or union value was broken
